snapshot_rule: last commit touching a declared model path within each rolling 30-day window, anchored on the first such commit

inclusion_criteria.requires: at least one dbt_project.yml with resolvable model-paths

core.rationale: the descriptors describe most of the reported N, and the series is long enough for a trend

extended.rationale: meets the inclusion criteria but not the core thresholds

determinism.note: The original phase_4 script inserted nodes from a Python set, making D1_csi and D1_n_comm dependent on PYTHONHASHSEED. Sorted insertion removes that dependence.

ref_patterns: permissive, unanchored ref(...) including the two-argument form
parse.note: capture_mode on every edge row lets the strict parse be reconstructed exactly. Nodes come from the file listing, so the reparse moved M and left N identical on all 5,034 shared snapshots.
